item.title: ClickFix Fake-CAPTCHA Social-Engineering Kit with IP Fencing and 19-Language Localization
item.description: High severity — social-engineering · N/A (social-engineering technique, not a software vulnerability). Status: PoC (benign placeholder payload). Affects: End users of Windows workstations (via Run dialog / PowerShell paste-and-execute); no vulnerable software component. Tags: clickfix, fake-captcha, clipboard-injection, ip-fencing, localization, social-engineering, phishing, run-dialog, cloudflare-worker.
